entries.id: .oxlint-plugins/__tests__/public-case-law-db-boundary.test.ts::public-law relation scan > public and mixed reads import runtime schema tables by name
entries.reason: The unchanged case timed out at 5 seconds in run 40967042529 while the isolated case completes in 324 ms. Its shared oxlint process scheduling makes the fixed timeout depend on other lint cases.

entries.id: apps/api/src/handlers/case-law/decisions/court-vocabulary-plan.postgres.test.ts::published court walks (postgres) > vocabulary and browse seek published index ranges at both corpus sizes
entries.reason: The unchanged plan test passed in run 40647999241 and reported one heap fetch in run 40652291069. VACUUM visibility-map state depends on concurrent transaction snapshots; the exact-zero assertion needs an isolated visibility fixture.

entries.id: apps/api/src/handlers/case-law/ingestion/adapters/pl-ncourt.test.ts::the tip > a lap lists closed days only, from where the walk stopped to today
entries.reason: The adapter captures the UTC date before fetching; the assertion recomputes it after fetching, so a UTC date change during the request changes the expected end date.

entries.id: apps/api/src/handlers/time-entries/suggestions/suggestions.integration.test.ts::time entry suggestions integration > an accepted suggestion's tail past midnight covers the next day's first minutes
entries.reason: The midnight-tail case reads shared current-day fixture activity, so unrelated chat rows change its expected engagement minutes. Keep reporting failures while the fixture date is isolated.

entries.id: apps/api/src/lib/case-law/sitemap-removal-refresh.postgres.test.ts::monthly sitemap removal fence (postgres) > a concurrent removal cannot be republished by a monthly count
entries.reason: Run 40967042529 retained a whole-country change after the fixture invoked refresh twice. Each refresh has a wall-clock run budget and may return pending, so a fixed invocation count does not guarantee that fixture changes are drained.
